dedicated.name: Colt's Targeting Goggles

why_by_stat.AllATK%: Colt requires high Attack to gain advantage over her enemies.

dedicated.story:
"It was old, so I simply gave you a new one. That should help improve your marksmanship, too."

Despite having excellent eyesight, Colt still wore a pair of old scope glasses —a cherished memento of a hunter she once knew— out of habit. Out of concern for Colt's safety, Pallanus advised her to remove them during training, then secretly gifted Colt a pair of high-precision, state-of-the-art goggles. Deeply moved by this seemingly nonchalant yet thoughtful gesture, Colt came to acknowledge Pallanus as her one true superior.

lore:
Colt is a soldier from the slums of Telus.
She was abandoned as an infant and grew up among beggars and outcasts in the slums.
Gifted with a natural talent for combat, she made a name for herself as a fixer, but she got caught up in a dangerous military experiment. That's when she met Pallanus, and her life took a different turn.
Recognizing Colt's potential, Pallanus brought her out of the slums and trained her to become a soldier.
At first, Colt felt conflicted about Pallanus, but over time, hostility gave way to gratitude.
Colt was given missions that could be seen as military crimes or unofficial operations Pallanus couldn't directly take part in. She completed them flawlessly, proving her worth.
Now a member of the Dark Knights, she's crossed time and space to arrive in Gaia.
Not to save Telus, but for Pallanus.
